title: 湾曲羽根ローター付きの屋根用タービン換気口
titleEn: Roof turbine vent with curved open-blade rotor
description: 屋根面の通気立上り部に配置するタービン式換気口の静的プロップ。中央が開口した角形水切り板、中空カラー、内部支持スポークと主軸、上下の保持リング、厚みを持つ20枚の湾曲羽根で構成した開放ローター、頂部軸受カバーを造形しています。既存の傘型排気カウルではなく、回転部の羽根籠を表した構成です。屋根と接続ダクトは付属せず、回転、風力駆動、換気流量、雨仕舞、防火や建築基準への適合は実装・検証していません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.733 × 0.769 × 0.733 m、10,676三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A static turbine-vent prop for a roof ventilation riser, with a genuinely open square flashing throat, hollow collar, internal spindle supports, upper and lower retaining rings, twenty thick curved vanes forming an open rotor cage, and a top bearing cover. This depicts a rotating-blade assembly rather than a mushroom exhaust cowl. Roof and connecting duct are omitted. No rotation, wind drive, airflow, weather sealing, fire performance or building-code compliance is implemented or validated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.733 × 0.769 × 0.733 m; 10,676 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
